pages.text: Auram Aspects$(br2)All Arcane Archives items and blocks have registered Thaumcraft aspects. Notably, Radiant Quartz is a source of Praecantatio.$(br2)Crucible Crucible

If you have a $(l:arcanearchives:gems/rivertear)Rivertear$(/l) somewhere in your inventory (or slotted in a $(l:arcanearchives:items/gemsocket)Gem Socket$(/l)), right clicking a Crucible will refill it with water.
Arcane Arsenal is not enabled; some features for this section are not present.
Infusion Matrix Infusion$(br2)$(l:arcanearchives:blocks/rawquartzcluster)Raw Quartz Clusters$(/l) can be used as an infusion stabilizer.
